address: No.1 Neusoft Avenue, Qingchengshan Town, Dujiangyan City, Chengdu, Sichuan 611844, China
description: Chengdu Neusoft University is a private undergraduate university founded by Neusoft Holdings in 2003, located at the foot of Mount Qingcheng in Dujiangyan, Chengdu. Specializing in IT, software engineering, digital media, business management and health technology, it enrolls over 20,000 students across 30 undergraduate programs using the industry-integrated TOPCARES talent model. As Sichuan's first independent private本科 university to host full-time international students, it blends enterprise-partnered applied education with a scenic UNESCO-heritage campus.

landmarks.description: The grand paifang-style main entrance on Neusoft Avenue welcoming students to the Qingchengshan campus in Dujiangyan.
landmarks.name: University Main Gate (大学正门)

landmarks.description: The campus library holds 800,000+ print volumes and 1.1 million e-books, focused on computing, information management and digital arts.
landmarks.name: University Library (图书馆)

landmarks.description: Core teaching block for computer science, software engineering and information programs with 79专业 laboratories including IoT, VR and security labs.
landmarks.name: Software Engineering Teaching Building (软件工程教学楼)

landmarks.description: Open-air stadium and lakeside sports grounds used for PE, military training, football and campus games.
landmarks.name: Sports Stadium (体育场)

landmarks.description: The university sits at the foot of Mount Qingcheng, a UNESCO World Heritage Taoist mountain with misty forested peaks behind campus.
landmarks.name: Mount Qingcheng Backdrop (青城山)

landmarks.description: Minutes from campus, the 2,000-year-old Dujiangyan Irrigation System is a UNESCO site and a living classroom for field trips.
landmarks.name: Dujiangyan Irrigation System (都江堰水利工程)

motto: To Learn and to Apply (精勤博学，学以致用)
